summary: Add the foreign key NOT VALID, deploy, retire, clear orphans, then validate.

stages.description: New rows are checked; existing rows are not yet.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT account_user_referrer_fk FOREIGN KEY (referrer_id) REFERENCES account_user (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED NOT VALID

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Dangling references point at nothing; clear them, then validate.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET referrer_id = NULL WHERE referrer_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_user r WHERE r.id = account_user.referrer_id)
ALTER TABLE account_user VALIDATE CONSTRAINT account_user_referrer_fk
